subject: Q3 tranche sequencing — capacity arbitration for BrightBridge / AtlasAI
content:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Maddox <kate@brightbridge.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Initial: BrightBridge dedicated sizing request & sequencing proposal

Hi Kate —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our intake, BrightBridge is requesting a Q3 tranche: 24x A100-equivalent GPUs (8 T/slot) reserved for a 6 month window starting July 1. The ask is to keep latency sub-200ms for the 2k token p95 path and allow burst to 36x for scheduled model training windows.

I'm attaching the request summary (BrightBridge_capacity_request_v1.pdf). Early thoughts: the combination of high p95 and a large burst window will require either guaranteed dedicated pools or explicit time-slicing with preemption guarantees for other customers.

Can you confirm the business priority for this deal (ARR / reference), and whether BrightBridge can commit to a partial up-front tranche if we propose a phased allocation?

Next steps I propose:
- Vanessa / Ops: run a quick feasibility check against Q3 fleet (we have a maintenance window in late June)
- Mina: draft a customer-friendly sequencing option (split vs. time-slice vs. overcommit)
- Kate / BrightBridge: confirm runway flexibility (can they accept a 4+2 phased start)

Appreciate a quick thumbs-up — we have AtlasAI in parallel asking about the same July window and we should coordinate.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

-----
From: Kate Maddox <kate@brightbridge.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement <procure@brightbridge.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Initial: BrightBridge dedicated sizing request & sequencing proposal

Ben, thanks — appreciate the clear next steps. A few clarifications:

- BrightBridge can commit to an initial 16x tranche starting July 1 if the remainder can be guaranteed by Sept 1.
- The latency needs are strict during inference windows; training can be scheduled to off-peak but we need burst capability on at least one week per month.
- We prefer a pricing model that has a partial up-front commitment and a smaller monthly true-up rather than a full 6-month commit.

Please loop in the ops/engineering folks — our procurement will need a clear delivery timeline and an SLA exception if the second tranche is conditional.

Thanks,
Kate Maddox
VP Product, BrightBridge

-----
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 31 Mar 2028 08:40:00 -0000
Subject: Fwd: BrightBridge dedicated sizing request — prioritization ask

Team — forwarding BrightBridge's note. AtlasAI is simultaneously asking for a July start for 20x GPUs with similar burst language; Atlas has a slightly lower committed ARR but is earlier in the procurement pipeline and has an active POC that needs predictable latency.

Ask: Ops + Eng, can you propose a sequencing plan that keeps both customers within SLO tolerances while minimizing our overall overcommit risk? Specifically:
- Options to consider: strict reservation (honor commitments, deny burst), phased tranche (16 then 8), or time-slice scheduling (shared pools with scheduled reservation windows).
- If strict reservation is technically required for BrightBridge to meet p95, we need a decision call on whether to prioritize BrightBridge vs AtlasAI. Financially, BrightBridge has higher ARR but AtlasAI's POC could convert faster.

I've attached the allocation runbook (allocation_runbook_v2.xlsx). Please respond with recommended sequencing + operational caveats by EOD Monday so Ben can update both customers.

—Vanessa
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

-----
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Apr 2028 15:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: BrightBridge dedicated sizing request — prioritization ask

Vanessa / team —

Thanks for the summary. Quick technical read: the fleet constraints for July are tight because of a scheduled node refresh in mid-June and an expected GPU shipment backfill that lands mid-August. That means absolute dedicated capacity is limited for the first half of July.

Feasible options and tradeoffs:
1) Strict reservation for BrightBridge (16 -> 8 later): guarantees p95 but prevents AtlasAI from getting capacity for the initial month. AtlasAI would need to fall back to hosted routing or accept higher latency.
2) Phased tranche (both customers): carve two smaller dedicated pools (e.g., BrightBridge 12 reserved + AtlasAI 8 reserved) and implement scheduled burst windows (weekly time-slices) that rotate; this maintains p95 for small windows but may not sustain BrightBridge's requested burst intensity. Requires prefix/KV cache warming windows; expect up to 20-30% higher token cost due to cold cache in rotated pools.
3) Time-slice / preemption model: run a shared pool with soft reservations and scheduler-enforced priority during BrightBridge's critical inference windows. Allows AtlasAI to run most of the time but risks transient p95 spikes during preemption. Engineering would need an SLA amendment.

Operational caveats:
- Any time-sliced solution needs explicit customer opt-in and a fallback model.
- We cannot guarantee the same p95 for burst periods unless we lock physical GPUs.
- We can support a compensation / discount model for AtlasAI if they accept lower guaranteed burst.

My recommendation: propose a customer-facing three-phased plan (confirmable in contract):
A) July start: BrightBridge 16 reserved (16 active, 4 preemptible from a shared pool) — temporary concession with discount for AtlasAI.
B) Aug 15: re-evaluate and expand to full requested sizing as hardware arrives.
C) If AtlasAI signs a conversion by mid-July, prioritize their expansion in the September tranche.

I'll list the exact engineering constraints in the attached ticket, but this gives a workable commercial path.

-Markus
Head of Inference Engineering, Redwood Inference

-----
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: sequencing proposal + customer-facing options (draft)

Team —

Based on Markus's technical options, I've drafted three customer-facing sequencing options (attached: proposed_sequence_table.csv). Short summary:

Option 1 (Conservative): Full reservation for BrightBridge (16 start, add 8 Sep). AtlasAI remains on hosted routing for July.
Commercial: higher ARR capture for BrightBridge; risk: AtlasAI may churn POC.

Option 2 (Shared time-slice): Split initial pool (BrightBridge 12 guaranteed + AtlasAI 8 guaranteed) with weekly scheduled burst windows for BrightBridge; implement prefix warming and KV cache handoff.
Commercial: lower immediate ARR but preserves both relationships. Requires a 10% surcharge for burst windows.

Option 3 (Preemptible fabric): Shared pool with BrightBridge higher priority during defined inference windows; AtlasAI gets discounted steady-state access, and both sign SLA caveats.

Recommended customer ask to BrightBridge: accept Option 2 and commit to a partial upfront of 50% of the initial tranche. For AtlasAI: offer Option 2 as default with a trial warranty and a one-time migration credit if they commit to a paid tranche by Aug 1.

If leadership signs off, I can convert Option 2 into contract language and a rollout playbook.

-Mina
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

-----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Maddox <kate@brightbridge.ai>, Atlas AI Ops <atlas-team@atlasai.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 16:30:00 -0000
Subject: Decision: July sequencing and commercial terms (BrightBridge / AtlasAI)

Kate, Atlas team —

Thank you for your patience. After reviewing the technical constraints and commercial signals, Redwood will proceed with Option 2 (Shared time-slice) as the primary path for July with these commercial commitments:

- BrightBridge: 12x guaranteed GPUs effective July 1, with scheduled weekly burst windows enabling up to +6 GPUs during a single allocated window (pre-scheduled). To secure the additional 4 GPUs in July and the final 8 GPUs by Sept 1, BrightBridge to sign a partial upfront (50% of July tranche) and a Sep true-up clause in the SOW.
- AtlasAI: 8x guaranteed GPUs effective July 1 with discounted burst windows outside BrightBridge's scheduled critical windows. Redwood will provide a one-time migration credit of $25k if AtlasAI converts to a paid tranche by Aug 1.

Operational notes:
- Engineering will implement rotating prefix warming; expect a 15-25% token cost delta during rotated windows.
- We will log all burst events and provide BrightBridge and AtlasAI with a monthly burst report.
- If hardware backfill arrives earlier than expected, we will accelerate the Sep tranche rollout.

Actions:
- Ben: circulate the draft SOW and collect signature from BrightBridge by Friday.
- Atlas team: confirm acceptance of the migration credit and the reduced burst guarantee by EOD Thursday.

This approach balances revenue capture and protects the POC pipeline. If either customer declines, we'll revert to strict reservation for the committing customer.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

-----
From: Kate Maddox <kate@brightbridge.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 18:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Decision: July sequencing and commercial terms (BrightBridge / AtlasAI)

Marcus / Ben —

We accept Option 2 and will sign the SOW with the 50% partial upfront. Please send the SOW and a calendar invite for the scheduled weekly burst windows so we can align our release cadence.

-Kate
VP Product, BrightBridge
